pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nihatādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.3: akataṃ kammaṃ dukkaṭaṃ kammaṃ puna kātabbaṃ kammaṃ anihataṃ dunnihataṃ puna nihanitabban ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ . . . ukkoṭessantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.6: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave jānaṃ . . . ukkoṭethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.9: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā jānaṃ . . . ukkoṭessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.10: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.11: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:1.12.1: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nihatādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.1.6: sāmaṃ vā jānāti aññe vā tassa ārocenti so vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.1.8: dhammena vinayena satthu sāsanena kataṃ, etaṃ yathādhammaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.1.10: cattāri adhikaraṇāni, vivādādhikaraṇaṃ anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ āpattādhikaraṇaṃ kiccādhikaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc63:2.1.12: akataṃ kammaṃ dukkaṭaṃ kammaṃ puna kātabbaṃ kammaṃ anihataṃ dunnihataṃ puna nihanitabban ti ukkoṭeti, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
